scope: Carrier power_som -> @som centroid preference only. No other contract is reclassified.

hardware_source.document: SNVSBD5D Rev. D, July 2022, section 11.1 page 47
hardware_source.review: Guidance addresses local switching loops, bypass/boot/feedback geometry, ground planes, wide/direct power paths, thermal copper and SW area. It does not specify an all-component subsystem-centroid 90-degree cutoff toward the SoM body. Routing, parasitics and thermal performance cannot be established by this angle.

counterexample.result: Strict policy fails only after unrelated TP movement in all four reflections. Regulator, output capacitors and SoM are unchanged. Reviewed policy retains the unsatisfied measurement as advisory; missing SoM geometry still fails.
counterexample.limit: Isolated centroid diagnostic without footprint geometry; not a physically qualified board.

change.policy: Added explicit facing_advisory_basis with review provenance; planner and final gate use the existing shared policy mechanism.
change.independent_diff_check: Parsed HEAD and changed contracts, removed the new advisory field, and asserted exact JSON equality. Local structures, roles, hot-loop/bypass/feedback checks, flow and far checks are untouched.
change.limits: A negative angle is not relabeled satisfied. Existing unresolved-role/geometry failures are retained. No new substitute angle or distance threshold invented.

verification.scope: Placement gates, source-policy audits, floorplan, failure receipts, legalize/precision accounting, compact facing and refit-clearance. Not an exhaustive native suite.

screen.checks: fanout, ratsnest, local placement contracts and flow true; hard_red=0
screen.acceptance: Screen only. Independent full qualification PASS is recorded in 2026-10-18-carrier-161x150-qualification.json. No controlled speedup or matched Python comparison claimed.
